checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 9:16 and the clip is 15 s.

must.item: Clear straight-sided jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label
must.why: Straight-sided clear glass jar, ivory wax, one wick, no label. The wick is tall and the wax looks slightly odd.
It is one continuous shot with a slow orbit. The jar and wax look the same throughout.

must.item: Warm evening light and gentle camera movement
must.why: Sunset glow, with a slow push-in and drift across the frames.

must.item: Both texts appear in order, spelled exactly
must.why: The first line reads 'A little eveing calm', which is misspelled. The closing line is correct.
The clip has sound, but the audio content cannot be judged from frames.

faults.what: Opening headline is misspelled as 'eveing' (missing the 'n'), in both frames where it shows. A client would reject this.
Text sits over the jar and wax, and is a little hard to read against the bright wax.
The wick is unusually tall, and the wax surface looks a bit odd. Resolution is low at 480p.

summary: The video is a good, calm, warm candle shot with the right jar and a correct 'Find your glow' ending, but the opening text is misspelled 'A little eveing calm', so it needs a fix.
